name: v2src-poolefforig
desc: POOLING / FLUID, the OTHER side of the same bracket. `Synovitis` was explicitly pulled back to 'original_mean' - the NO-JITTER mean - which is evidence that jittered windows hurt at least one diffuse finding. `Effusion` is diffuse too and keeps the jittered mean. This gives it the exact treatment Synovitis received. Paired with `poolfluidmax`: one of the two directions, or neither, is the answer.
